## Body

SQLite optimization reviews need both query correctness and consumer-wide cost proof. At PR315 head 916de5628b586eee641053915de5227806c5e050, LIST_LIVE_SQL was equivalent to LIST_SQL under 1,250 full-row/order controls, and migration 0049 preserved 50,000 rows on an isolated v48 schema. But reap_with_reason still fetched all historical rows for receipt.after on every non-dry 5-second sweep (crates/daemon/src/reaper.rs:268-274). Moving only the initial read to live_only left a second full scan in normal operation; R315-F001 asks for the same live filter on the fresh final count, not before-minus-reaped arithmetic.

Pane-first dispatch remains correct with live_only; all predicates stay bound and absent differs from empty. The missing-index production-adapter regression closes R312-N1; provided L1/L2/L3 receipts fail their intended assertions. Treat manual CREATE INDEX repeatability separately from sqlx-ledger reopening. An older binary intentionally refuses a newer user_version even for an index-only migration.

Evidence: CI run 44885298204, rust-test job 136789170807, artifact 14699603162: 2,773 tests, zero failures/skips, including 17 reaper/death-sweep tests and five index tests. Local read-only review trees remain C25 dependency-limited; do not claim the quick harness gate passed when it failed from missing local tools.

magicWand: a recording Registry around the actual sweep should enforce live_only on every recurring list call, including receipt bookkeeping. difficulties: constant-level EXPLAIN/dispatch proof cannot detect a second unchanged consumer; local quick gates surface missing TypeScript dependencies and an unrelated ambient Biome version. Keep evidence scoped and never turn per-query timings into an end-to-end sweep claim.
